description: Seed data for the internal AgentRoster Blueprint product map.

spaces.name: Homepage / Public Site
spaces.purpose: Explain AgentRoster simply and route visitors into the right wedge: individual, business, service provider, tool/company partner, or audit.
spaces.promise: Keep your stack. Add the Brain.
pages: AI Work Graph Audit Landing Page
spaces.notes: Needs design; copy ready

spaces.name: Pricing / Packaging
spaces.purpose: Show the two individual plans, two business plans, one service provider plan, and Advanced coming soon without revealing too much.
spaces.promise: Start useful. Upgrade when you are ready to connect your world.
spaces.notes: Needs final prices for Individual/Business/client workspace; Service Provider $179 direction set

spaces.name: Onboarding / Quick Start
spaces.purpose: Beat the cold start by collecting role, industry, goals, tools, team/company context, and optional email/tool connections.
spaces.promise: Give Scout enough context to make AgentRoster useful immediately.
spaces.notes: Launch P0

spaces.name: Brain Build / Scout Interview
spaces.purpose: Let users talk or type through their work, tools, clients, projects, skills, costs, and goals; turn it into structured operating graph context.
spaces.promise: Turn one conversation into your personal or company operating graph.
spaces.notes: Launch P0 with lightweight version; richer voice later

spaces.name: This Is What We Heard
spaces.purpose: Show users what Scout understood, what is confirmed, inferred, missing, rejected, or stale before updating Brain state.
spaces.promise: Nothing important enters your Brain without context, source, and review.
spaces.notes: Launch P0

spaces.name: Brain Snapshot / Reports
spaces.purpose: Give users the first visual summary of what AgentRoster understands about their people, agents, tools, skills, work, costs, gaps, and next actions.
spaces.promise: See your starting operating picture in one place.
spaces.notes: Launch P0

spaces.name: Feed / Scout Brief
spaces.purpose: Deliver personalized awareness and intelligence based on role, industry, stack, goals, and saved/watched items.
spaces.promise: Scout shows what changed, why it matters, and what you should do next.
spaces.notes: Launch P0

spaces.name: Scout Inbox / Brain Backlog
spaces.purpose: Turn missing context, confirmations, recommendations, approvals, and profile-building questions into an ongoing queue.
spaces.promise: Scout keeps asking the right small questions so your Brain gets smarter over time.
spaces.notes: Launch P0/P1

spaces.name: Brain Connect
spaces.purpose: A visual command center for connected, detected, mentioned, unknown, and suggested tools/categories powering the user/company AI Work Graph.
spaces.promise: Connect the tools you already use and see what AgentRoster knows, what is missing, and what should happen next.
spaces.notes: Plan 2 wow unlock

spaces.name: ARM / AgentRoster Management
spaces.purpose: CRM-style operating views for managing the user/company ecosystem: people, agents, tools, skills, work, costs, access, and decisions.
spaces.promise: Manage your AgentRoster ecosystem in familiar list, board, graph, and profile views.
spaces.notes: Launch P0 with static/mocked layouts; deeper graph later

spaces.name: Directory / Ecosystem
spaces.purpose: Map the AI economy: tools, agents, companies, categories, comparisons, providers, jobs, and skills.
spaces.promise: Find what matters in the AI economy and understand where it fits.
spaces.notes: Launch P0

spaces.name: Skills Space
spaces.purpose: Create the AI-era skills layer across tools, roles, workflows, companies, agents, service providers, and people.
spaces.promise: Find, save, learn, publish, and later prove the skills needed for AI-era work.
spaces.notes: Launch v1 with official/verifiable company-owned skills

spaces.name: Service Provider Network
spaces.purpose: Give AI consultants/agencies/trainers/enablement firms a credibility profile, client audit toolkit, skills/how-to publishing, and discovery surface.
spaces.promise: Show your AI work, run client audits, publish skills, and become discoverable to people and companies that need help.
spaces.notes: Launch with $179/mo plan direction; client workspace price TBD

spaces.name: Atlas Profile Build / Compatibility Network
spaces.purpose: Atlas maps the ecosystem by helping tools, agents, SaaS companies, service providers, and partners complete rich profiles and become discoverable/Brain Ready.
spaces.promise: Help AgentRoster understand where your product fits so users can discover it when it matches their goals, workflows, roles, skills, and stack gaps.
spaces.notes: Launch with claim/profile build; deeper analytics later

spaces.name: AI Work Graph Audit
spaces.purpose: Self-serve or provider-led audit that maps what exists, what is missing, what is risky, what it costs, and what should happen next.
spaces.promise: Run your AI Work Graph Audit and see the pieces on the table before making AI decisions.
spaces.notes: Launch wedge; Lite free/included; full tied to Plan 2/provider

spaces.name: Business Brain
spaces.purpose: Company/team operating graph across people, agents, tools, work, skills, costs, access, risks, and decisions.
spaces.promise: Give teams the clearest operating picture of their human + agent stack.
spaces.notes: Business Plan 2; v1 scope should be realistic

spaces.name: Cost / Ledger Layer
spaces.purpose: Track software/AI stack costs, plans, seats, renewals, owners, overlaps, and later token/API/usage spend.
spaces.promise: See what your AI operating stack costs and what value it supports.
spaces.notes: Launch v1 basic; deeper finance later

spaces.name: Provenance / Audit Log
spaces.purpose: Show where every claim came from, when it was learned, how confident AgentRoster is, and when it was last audited.
spaces.promise: Trust the Brain because every important claim has source, date, confidence, and review status.
spaces.notes: Launch P0 as simple source/confidence pattern

spaces.name: Integrations / Brain Ready
spaces.purpose: Track integration categories, native depth, middleware paths, MCP/API readiness, and Brain Ready status.
spaces.promise: Broad compatibility, deeper native mapping where graph value is highest.
spaces.notes: Blueprint must map now; product v1 selectively

spaces.name: Decision Sandbox
spaces.purpose: Scenario testing layer for agent access, workflow changes, automation, approvals, cost/risk, and human/agent/tool decisions before they go live.
spaces.promise: Test decisions before agents act.
spaces.notes: Show coming soon; do not overbuild launch

spaces.name: Jobs / Talent Layer
spaces.purpose: Use AI job postings as a data source for hiring demand, tool adoption, skill requirements, company AI activity, and user opportunity.
spaces.promise: Understand which jobs, skills, tools, and companies matter in the AI economy.
spaces.notes: Source Pack launch surface; Blueprint should map

spaces.name: Answers / Public Q&A
spaces.purpose: Public, sourced, indexable Q&A layer for AI tools, agents, workflows, skills, costs, careers, and business use cases.
spaces.promise: Answer the questions people already ask about the AI economy, then route them into Scout, Brain, Stack, Jobs, Skills, and Directory.
spaces.notes: Blueprint should map

spaces.name: Work Portfolio
spaces.purpose: Let users prove AI-era capability through projects, skills, outputs, reports, and artifacts.
spaces.promise: Show what you can do, not just what tools you know.
spaces.notes: Future but important

spaces.name: Communities / Topic Hubs
spaces.purpose: Agent-led topic hubs for roles, industries, and AI use cases before empty forums.
spaces.promise: Find the questions, tools, skills, jobs, and briefings relevant to your AI community.
spaces.notes: Future

spaces.name: Real-World Services / Workshops
spaces.purpose: Support workshops, readiness sessions, cohorts, enterprise audits, city/university programs, and training tied to AgentRoster data.
spaces.promise: Bring AgentRoster’s AI Work Graph into real-world training, audits, and enablement.
spaces.notes: Future but strategic

spaces.name: Admin / Internal Ops
spaces.purpose: Give AgentRoster operators internal control over content, profiles, page records, data quality, launch status, and moderation.
spaces.promise: Keep the ecosystem clean, sourced, and buildable.
spaces.notes: Blueprint v0 should include internal admin view
